title: Opening to clouds - assembly preview
creative_order: univers -> enkelt sinn -> skapende handlinger -> samklang -> skyer

render.note: Preview is constant 24 fps for auto-play and deterministic seeking. 30 fps sources (brains/impulses/vortex) are frame-resampled to 24 fps for the preview only; integration keeps each scene's native rate under the site's single scroll clock (Codex owns integration).

handoff.handoff_frame_role: last cloud frame before the existing Bergen-prison gate reveal
handoff.note: Scope ends at the cloud handoff. The existing approved descent (earth-gate) and everything after (prison, officers, C7) are preserved unchanged and owned by the rest of the film.

segments.camera: push-in along optical axis, point -> star-streaks -> face-on spiral galaxy
segments.reuse: Opens on black star-space with a single point of light, matching the required black-starfield entry; establishes cosmic depth without text or narrator.

segments.camera: continued push/roll into the spiral, whirl into nebula haze; trimmed BEFORE the dense brain field to avoid a second brain build-up
segments.reuse: Carries the galaxy motif forward (galaxy->galaxy join) and begins the move into the depth of the field toward the minds.

segments.camera: drift through a field of small transparent brains, settling toward one that fills the frame
segments.reuse: Moves attention from the many to a single mind (enkelt sinn); the next motif grows out of this one without a camera jump.

segments.camera: lateral drift; golden synapse lines ignite between the brains
segments.reuse: Concrete creative acts read as synapses firing between minds; no invented people or authentic documentation.

segments.camera: pull-back; the brain network binds and begins to turn into a single spiral whirl
segments.reuse: Binds the separate acts into one legible collective movement (samklang) and turns the motif back toward the cosmic.

segments.camera: green vortex forms and resolves to Earth in space at sunrise; trimmed to start at the vortex, skipping the redundant third brain intro
segments.reuse: 'When everyone contributes' resolves the collective into the shared world; ends on Earth, matching earth-gate's first frame for a clean handoff (dY=7).

segments.camera: Earth in space -> warp down through the atmosphere to full cloud cover; STOPS at the cloud, before the Bergen-prison gate reveal
segments.reuse: Leads into the existing approved cloud arrival and preserves it. The out-frame (full cloud) is the handoff; the existing clip continues unchanged from here into the prison, owned by the rest of the film.
